title: Prospective model-session reuse and measurement-validity investigation
question: On the selected cases, how do EAL and ordinary workflows differ in grounded task completion and cumulative resources across fresh sessions, donor/recipient models and native-tool access?

scope.system_or_population: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases, including six diagnostic and two additional cases.
scope.conditions: Both donor models crossed with both recipient models and tool settings; EAL host collection remains available with native tools disabled.
scope.spatial_scope: Isolated synthetic project directories and OpenAI Responses API.
scope.temporal_scope: Initial session plus two fresh recipient sessions, two repetitions per configuration.
exclusions: No human participants or authoring-effort estimate.
No population model-class, isolated reasoning or notation effect.
A host-installed threshold method only; no general reasoning-mode claim.

claims.statement: The configured workflows have observable task-completion, failure and resource profiles on the selected repeated-session cases.
claims.scope_limit: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases, including six diagnostic and two additional cases.
claims.success_consequence: Report the measured profiles and candidate follow-up questions.
claims.failure_consequence: Retain losses, ties, failed attempts and inconclusive measurements without a benefit claim.

assumptions.statement: Independent reference arithmetic, EAL source and context preserve the same task distinctions.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Boundary/adverse reference tests and 24 case/session source-to-context calibration checks.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Stop before API calls on failed calibration; suspend affected empirical interpretation.

assumptions.statement: Provider responses respect the pinned snapshot and declared interface.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Snapshot verification, retained requests, within-session reasoning replay and common structured answer schema.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Record failure; stop on access, budget or snapshot mismatch. New configuration needs live verification.

constructs.name: Grounded reference-task completion
constructs.definition: Decision and basis agree with an independent full-information reference; definite answers also cite the observed reading and time.
constructs.scope: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases, including six diagnostic and two additional cases.
validity_evidence: Known positive, negative, missing and expired examples; source/context calibration; separate format and file-side-effect checks.
validity_threats: Grounding is agreement with fixture facts, not proof that the model consulted a source.
An appropriate abstention with unavailable evidence can miss full-information task completion.
Simple threshold tasks underrepresent engineering work.

measurements.observable: Decision, basis, reading, observed_at, explanation, format validity and independent file-write result
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: answers.AnswerParser and scoring.ReferenceScorer; JSON parsing and side-effect validation are separate.
measurements.timing: Every initial and recipient session; every attempt retained.
measurements.preprocessing: Primary grounded_match plus decision_match, decision_and_basis_match, consistency, false definite answer, abstention, no-answer, format and file outcomes. Any voluntarily cited measurement or time must agree with the current reference even when the answer abstains.
measurements.calibration: Hand-calculated references, inclusive measurement/threshold boundaries, exclusive assumption end, known adverse labels and real EAL context checks.
measurements.reliability: Deterministic scoring and two API repetitions; model variability remains observable rather than erased by retries.
measurements.validity: Measures reference agreement; human effort and free-text argument quality remain outside scope.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same outcome schema and arithmetic across arms, models and sessions.
measurements.reactivity: Common provider schema constrains output format and prompts optional natural notes.
measurements.error_model: Invalid optional files do not discard an answer. Malformed answer JSON is no-answer; missing API usage remains unknown. No answer-dependent repair.
measurements.blinding: Oracle and current external fixture state are absent from initial prompts; references are calculated after responses and do not inspect arm labels.

measurements.observable: Per-session and cumulative API cost/tokens, timing, native probes, host collections/reuses and setup time
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: provider.BudgetedClient append-only ledger, session.SessionRunner, resources.ResourceSummary and reporting.ReportBuilder.
measurements.scale_or_units: Seconds, token/call counts and estimated USD
measurements.timing: Initial and each recipient session, then total per condition.
measurements.preprocessing: Count host and native collector calls separately and together; retain all known usage and unknown costs; cost per grounded answer only when usage is complete. Cost/time per grounded answer require complete outcome coverage; collection and token completeness flags qualify subtotals.
measurements.calibration: Known-cost and unknown-cost ledger cases, forced-collection strategy and independent paired arithmetic.
measurements.reliability: Recorded monotonic durations and provider usage; no assertion that local collector timing represents remote infrastructure.
measurements.validity: Recorded machine/API resources only. Uncached price estimates exclude authoring, human effort and host infrastructure prices.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same serial provider transport, budgets, schema and accounting rules across arms.
measurements.reactivity: Budget stops may leave partial cells; logging uses append-only call records.
measurements.error_model: Started requests persist before transmission; interrupted journals and unobserved sessions remain distinguishable from zero work.
measurements.blinding: Mechanical aggregation does not use desired answer quality to select attempts.

design.rationale: A matched, crossed exploratory comparison measures configured workflows; calibration checks instrument adequacy before live collection.
design.setting: Automated live API calls on synthetic projects.
design.temporal_structure: Initial plus two new recipient sessions with retained project state and empty conversation history.
design.assignment_method: Cross eight cases, two donor models, two receiver models, two native-tool settings, two repetitions and ordinary/EAL arms. Shuffle matched blocks and arm order using seed 20260928.
design.allocation_concealment: Not applicable: no human allocation; case oracle never enters a prompt.
design.masking: Deterministic scorer reads only decision/basis and the case reference.
design.comparator: Fresh ordinary prompt sessions with the same specification, native-tool setting and naturally produced project notes; no supplied runbook, curated prior tool results or previous conversation.

units.target_population_or_system: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases, including six diagnostic and two additional cases.
units.sampling_frame: Eight purposively chosen cases: six diagnostic cases informed by a prior run and two additional lower-threshold storage cases.
units.observational_unit: Session answer, API attempt or collector event.
units.assignment_unit: Matched block order and within-block arm order; all declared configurations are enumerated.
units.analysis_unit: Within-case matched workflow differences, retaining session, donor, receiver, native tools, repetition and cohort; repeated sessions and calls are dependent.
inclusion_criteria: Every planned sequence and session retained.
units.recruitment_or_selection: No people. Models and cases are selected for bounded operational coverage.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Pre-authored EAL source, typed threshold method, TOML collector and persisted observations, with host context prepared anew for each session.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Host evidence acquisition/reuse and threshold evaluation, with task-sufficient output distinctions.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: One host assessment per EAL session; two recipient sessions and two repetitions.
manipulation_checks: Retain collected/reused counts, checked context and method outputs.
off_target_checks: Common specification, native tool and answer schema; EAL adds host computation as part of the workflow treatment.
recovery_checks: No previous provider response or tool transcript in new session input.

controls.description: Fresh ordinary prompt sessions with the same specification, native-tool setting and naturally produced project notes; no supplied runbook, curated prior tool results or previous conversation.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Curated baseline knowledge changing the intended comparator.
controls.implementation: Project.files and explicit new-session messages; only naturally produced notes persist.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Inspect raw session inputs and file snapshots; suspend claims if leaked current fixture/oracle data entered prompts.

controls.description: Independent references, explicit positive/negative calculations and before-API source/context calibration.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Oracle leakage, status-as-ground-truth, history leakage or budget omission.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Failed calibration blocks live calls and is reported as invalid measurement.

controls.description: Optional separate ablation plan adds EAL with reuse=fresh, retaining the ordinary primary comparator.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Mistaking reduced native calls for reduced total collection or attributing host benefits exclusively to reuse.
controls.implementation: conditions.EALContext and ablation-plan.json: two diagnostic cases, both donors/receivers/tool settings, one repetition, three arms and two recipients.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Compare eal versus eal_fresh within the ablation run; count native and host calls. Do not pool plans or infer an isolated notation effect.

confounds.description: Reasoning configuration varies with model family; EAL changes information availability and computation; initial notes arise independently.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Whole-workflow differences cannot identify isolated reasoning, notation or every EAL component.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Cross donors with every case, match recipient configuration and repetition, retain independent initial outputs, separate cohorts and resource paths.
confounds.diagnostic: Report exact snapshots and settings, same/different model transition, actual messages, case and session effects.
confounds.residual_risk: No population, human or pure reasoning claim. Two new cases are not independently authored confirmation.

estimands.population_or_system: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases, including six diagnostic and two additional cases.
estimands.comparator: Fresh ordinary prompt sessions with the same specification, native-tool setting and naturally produced project notes; no supplied runbook, curated prior tool results or previous conversation.
estimands.time: Initial and each of two subsequent new sessions; cumulative resources.
estimands.summary_measure: Grounded task completion per planned session, paired within-case differences and observed ranges, false definite answers, abstentions, format/file outcomes and resource totals.
estimands.interpretation: Fixed-case observed workflow profiles, conditional on calibration. Unobserved outcomes retain bounds; API calls are not independent cases.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Descriptive counts from retained answers and resource records; independent task arithmetic supplies the criterion. No population causal target.
identified_parameters: Observed reference-match and resource profiles for executed configurations and retained paired differences.
threats: Misattribution of host calls or authoring cost
diagnostics: Full allocation and raw request records
rescue_actions: Stop invalid measurements; revise the protocol and run in a new directory; preserve historical results.

sampling.method: Fixed purposive cases with crossed donors/recipients/tools, matched arms and two independent executions of each configuration.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Standard plan: 256 sequences, 768 sessions, at most 2304 requests. Separate ablation: 48 sequences, 144 sessions, at most 432 requests.
inputs: Two repetitions and two recipient sessions
sampling.dependence_structure: Case clusters recur across arms, repetitions and sessions; no independent-sample count based on calls.
sampling.multiplicity: All descriptive contrasts retained; no tests, confidence intervals or significance claims.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Retain all planned rows; no-answer for attempted failed sessions, unknown for unobserved sessions.
sampling.result: Coverage and variability on selected cases; two repetitions do not justify model-class precision.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Separate decisions, basis, citation agreement, false assertions, abstentions and side effects; provide bounds for unobserved completion.
sampling.stopping_implications: Stop on invalid calibration, fatal access/snapshot/budget failure, or external 120-minute job ceiling. Partial results remain partial.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Save plan, protocol, case specifications, assignments, source identities and raw messages before corresponding live observations; no answer-dependent retries.
analysis.exclusion_lock: No post-scheduling omissions or replacement of failed units.

models.model_or_procedure: Independent reference scoring followed by separate cohort/session cells, case-level paired contrasts and complete resource counts.

contrasts: Primary EAL minus ordinary within case, donor, receiver, native tools, repetition and session.
Secondary EAL minus forced-fresh EAL in the separate ablation plan.
analysis.uncertainty: Observed paired differences and ranges by case/cohort; no population intervals. Unobserved completion rates use best/worst bounds. Repetitions and sessions are not new sampled tasks.
analysis.multiplicity: Exploratory descriptive reporting of all specified cells and contrasts.
analysis.missing_data: Missing answers fail attempted completion; unobserved outcomes remain unknown; unknown API usage prevents finite cost-per-answer claims.
analysis.stopping_rule: Fixed plan with at most three requests per session, 4096 output tokens, 32768 request bytes, 90-second request timeout and USD 2 reservation ledger; manual workflow has a 120-minute ceiling.
robustness_checks: Separate model transitions and session indices.
Compare quality dimensions and all collector/API paths.
Retain historical scores and any sensitivity interpretation separately.
software_and_versions: Python >=3.11; package 2.15.0; EAL/2; packet/context /2; protocol 2.0.0; pinned snapshots and Git identity.
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Invalid measurement blocks calls. Partial or conflicting results remain inconclusive for comparative benefit; additional independent tasks are needed for generalisation.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Calibration passes and all planned observations are recorded.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Describe observed quality and resource trade-offs, including losses and ties. Do not promote the fixed-case profile to general superiority.

claim_effects.rationale: Replace conjectured profiles with recorded fixed-case differences.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases, including six diagnostic and two additional cases.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: A failed instrument check overrides outcome interpretation.
decision_matrix.next_action: Select independently authored tasks targeting remaining uncertainties.

decision_matrix.decision_rule: Record invalid measurement and send zero API requests.

claim_effects.rationale: An inadequate measurement path cannot support the comparison.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases, including six diagnostic and two additional cases.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Repair and verify correspondence before a fresh run.
decision_matrix.next_action: Keep the failed calibration record and use a new output directory.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Calibration passes but execution stops early, costs are unknown, or an unanticipated measurement problem appears.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report partial coverage and bounds without a completed comparative conclusion.

claim_effects.rationale: Missing or invalid data leave the comparison unresolved.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases, including six diagnostic and two additional cases.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Identify the failure and retain all attempts.
decision_matrix.next_action: Correct the identified cause before any new declared run.

risks.mechanism: Selected simple tasks and models, plus repairs informed by earlier outcomes, limit generalisation.
risks.prevention: Separate diagnostic and additional cohorts and label all findings exploratory.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: Independent future tasks and reference review are required for confirmation.
risks.residual_risk: No general engineering, human or model-class claim.

researcher_degrees_of_freedom: New protocol specified after inspecting a historical run; six diagnostic cases remain discovery material.
Two additional cases are authored prospectively but not independently.
Plan fixes structured output, cases, repetitions, order and resource bounds before new responses.
negative_controls: Missing measurement cannot become a measured negative; an ended assumption cannot become ready.
positive_controls: Positive and negative computed threshold results, inclusive threshold boundaries.
falsification_checks: Current negative result alongside retained positive notes
Expired assumption with a still-fresh measurement
reporting_controls: All planned units, attempts and separate measurement dimensions retained.
residual_limitations: Pre-authored EAL and excluded authoring costs

ethics_and_safety.rationale: Synthetic project data and read-only local fixture collectors; no human participants.
mitigations: Do not record headers or credential values; collector inherits no provider environment.
Reserve cost before requests; no hidden retries.
monitoring: Append-only request journal and resource ceilings.
stopping_rules: Access failure, snapshot mismatch, unavailable model, quota or budget limit.
post_stop_actions: Retain attempts and incomplete-run report without spending on replacement models.

apparatus_or_data: Manual workflow with existing OPENAI_API_KEY secret
feasibility.access: Prior workflow accessed both pinned snapshots. The revised provider/schema configuration still requires live execution.
skills: Existing EAL implementation and provider adapter
resources: USD 2 maximum estimated API reservation budget per run
dependencies: Credentialed manual execution of the selected branch/plan
feasibility.fallback: Retain calibration or blocked/partial status accurately; no fabricated live results.

reproducibility.registration: Versioned prospective exploratory protocol; no external preregistration claimed.
immutable_materials: Per-run protocol, plan, cases, assignments, provenance, API journal and raw sessions.
reproducibility.data_plan: Retain all attempts and synthetic observations in new run directories; workflow artifacts retained for 90 days subject to repository limits; archive important run evidence before expiry.
reproducibility.code_plan: Existing Git repository and PR; no automatic workflow trigger.
reproducibility.randomisation_or_seed_plan: Seed 20260928 for matched-block and arm order. Repetitions are separate API executions; no deterministic provider seed claim.
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Snapshot protocol and fixture definitions; record Git revision, dirty state, implementation hashes, models, pricing, prompts, attempts and timestamps.
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: New protocol version and output directory for changes; preserve prior raw data and scores.
reproducibility.replication_plan: Repeat under declared resources and evaluate independently authored broader tasks before confirmation.

sources: User goal: reliable economical knowledge reuse across new sessions/models
Official OpenAI structured-output and reasoning contracts
change_log: 2.0.0: crossed prospective session design, separate measurement dimensions and task-sufficient host context.

method_selection.rationale: Calibrate the instrument, then describe complete workflow profiles on selected repeated-session tasks within a small budget.
method_selection.inference_framework: Descriptive fixed-case paired comparison. No general causal, population or significance claim.
alternatives_considered: A human study measures same/different-developer effort and authoring; that remains a separate operator-led investigation.
An equal-information structured-tool comparator isolates notation/computation but changes the requested ordinary-session comparator; reserve it for a separate component study.
A single model with reasoning varied would address a different configuration question.
A forced-fresh EAL arm is an optional secondary collection diagnostic with the primary comparator retained.

sources.citation: John W. Tukey (1980), We Need Both Exploratory and Confirmatory, The American Statistician 34, 23-25.
sources.design_consequence: Keep this exploratory pilot separate from an independent confirmatory study.

sources.citation: Cronbach, L. J. and Meehl, P. E. (1955), Construct validity in psychological tests, Psychological Bulletin 52, 281–302.
sources.design_consequence: Validate the intended answer-quality measurement and separate format/file side effects from its interpretation.

method_selection.information_criterion: Cover crossed donor/recipient/tools, two fresh recipient positions and two repetitions on eight cases; report variability rather than pretend to precise population inference.
permitted_conclusions: Observed quality/resource profiles on executed configurations.
excluded_conclusions: Pure reasoning, notation or intrinsic tool-capability effect
method_selection.discovery_confirmation_separation: Six cases remain diagnostic; two additional cases are prospective but not independently authored. Confirmation requires independently selected tasks.

assignment.procedure: Cross eight cases, two donor models, two receiver models, two native-tool settings, two repetitions and ordinary/EAL arms. Shuffle matched blocks and arm order using seed 20260928.
assignment.failure_response: Retain the affected unit and failure; suspend invalid measurements rather than silently deleting them.

collection.procedure: Run fresh sessions with common schema, bounded provider calls and durable request starts; preserve host and native observations.
collection.failure_response: Retain the affected unit and failure; suspend invalid measurements rather than silently deleting them.

scoring.procedure: Compare labels and numeric/time citations using independent arithmetic; record file and format outcomes separately.
scoring.failure_response: Retain the affected unit and failure; suspend invalid measurements rather than silently deleting them.

analysis.procedure: Report every cohort/session/configuration, matched differences, unknown bounds and initial/recipient/total resources.
analysis.failure_response: Retain the affected unit and failure; suspend invalid measurements rather than silently deleting them.

verification.case: Crossed donor/case coverage, matched allocation and fixed-seed replay
verification.expected_result: 256 unique standard sequences with all planned donor/recipient/tool/repetition combinations.
verification.observed_result: Passed: 256 unique standard sequences, both donors per case, matched arms and fixed-seed replay.

verification.case: Source/context calibration, fresh sessions, native masks, budget stops and incomplete provider replies
verification.expected_result: 24 calibration checks; complete starts and raw outcomes retained; no session history leakage.
verification.observed_result: Passed: 24 real EAL case/session calibrations; fresh message histories, native-tool masks, interrupted attempts and unknown costs retained.

verification.case: Negative measurements, expiry boundaries, incorrect citations, abstentions and rejected files
verification.expected_result: Independent expected labels; invalid file effects do not change a valid answer score.
verification.observed_result: Passed: threshold/freshness/assumption boundaries, adverse citations, partial answer fields and independent file-write outcomes.

verification.case: Known zero/nonzero paired differences, unknown costs and full partial-run denominator
verification.expected_result: Correct difference direction, all collector calls and explicit unobserved bounds.
verification.observed_result: Passed: known zero and +1 differences, complete planned denominators, missing session costs and unknown host/usage records.

verification.case: Scripted end-to-end execution using real EAL across both donors, recipients, tool masks and all three arms
verification.expected_result: 48 sequence rehearsal with 144 sessions, independent scoring and complete report; no empirical model claim.
verification.observed_result: Passed: 48 scripted sequences and 144 sessions through the real EAL runtime; journal reconstruction and offline report reproduction agree.

verification.expected_result: Pinned snapshots return real answers/usage under the new common structured schema.
